notes.title: Version 1.2.2 Released
Version 1.2.1 Released
Powers in the Basement is out on Steam!
notes.notes:
For all point-and-click adventurers out there, our classics-inspired game [b]Powers in the Basement[/b] is finally [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2520280/Powers_in_the_Basement]available on Steam[/url], together with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2630740/Powers_in_the_Basement_Extended_Soundtrack/]Extended Soundtrack DLC[/url] which sports [b]SB/SBPro, Gravis UltraSound and PC-Speaker renditions[/b] of selected pieces, alongside rearranged original [b]MT-32 music[/b]!

The game is free, but if you want to help us pixelate more stories, [b]consider purchasing the Extended Soundtrack and support our effort[/b]!

Best wishes for a playful holiday season ;)
